assets.title: Email Management System
assets.prompt:
Create one complete 16:9 widescreen PowerPoint cover slide as a polished, high-resolution raster image. Academic computer-science project presentation. Cohesive visual style for an entire slide deck: deep navy #172C3C, teal #117568, mint #8BD4C5, white and cool light gray; clean flat editorial vector illustration mixed with subtle isometric depth, generous whitespace, sharp professional sans-serif typography, no excessive glow. Make all text clearly readable and spelled exactly. Do not add extra text, logos or watermarks.
Slide 1 of 10. Navy background. Large editable-looking title on the left and a distinctive conceptual mail-workspace illustration on the right: a white envelope, a simple desktop monitor with abstract email rows, database cylinder and a small shield connected in a tidy composition. This is a conceptual illustration, not an actual screenshot.
Exact text:
"MAILDESK"
"Email Management System"
"Java Swing, JDBC, MySQL and the Gmail API"
"A desktop client with explainable spam review"
Small slide number "01 / 10".
The title should dominate. Use only these words. Keep everything inside safe margins.
